profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer| Backend Systems| Java, Cloud & Distributed Systems
profile.summary:
35+ years of software engineering experience.
Currently focusing on high rate data ingestion using data streaming applications, PostgreSql, and geospatial data processing.

Specialties: Streaming applications, Kafka, "cloud" applications to include integrating SQL,  NoSQL, streaming systems in enterprise systems.

positions.title: Sr Java Streaming Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for developing a financial streaming application, using Flink
and Java, for recreating a financial portfolio based on financial criteria
and the previous trading day’s financial information. The information
processed was stored locally and in Amazon S3. Also responsible for
developing an integration test and deploying the application for testing in
an enterprise Kubernetes environment. Development is in an
Agile/SCRUM process.
Technologies: Java, Protobuf, Flink, Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon S3,
Harness, Git, Gradle, Citrus, Confluence, Jira, TestNG
